notes.title: More games from Auro's lead designer!
notes.content:
Hi Dinofarm Games fans! It's me, Auro's lead designer, Keith Burgun. These days, Dinofarm isn't doing that much together, but I wanted to let you know about my own company, Keith Burgun Games, and the stuff I've been working on! First, let me just let you know that you can sign up [url=https://www.keithburgun.net/signup]here[/url] to get updates on everything I'm working on. But here's some bullet points you gotta know!

[list]
[*] First, if you don't know about Gem Wizards Tactics, you'll definitely want to get on that. It's kind of a lot like Auro, but if you had like 5-6 Auros doing battles against a hundred guys on a big map (and you can push people off the edges! A good amount of BUMPING). GWT is available [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1360270/Gem_Wizards_Tactics/]here[/url] on Steam now, on Android, iOS, and coming tomorrow on the [url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/gem-wizards-tactics-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url] and XBox platforms!
[*] If you like quick, portable, yet really deep card games that are about BUMPING, definitely check out my successfully kickstarted card game, Dragon Bridge! You can [url=https://www.coolstuffinc.com/p/305143]grab a copy for just $20 here at CoolStuffInc[/url].
[*] I also have a cool new 1 player digital card game/deckbuilder/roguelite coming soon, called Castle of the Secret Arts.
[*] I also also have another cool card game coming - more news on that soon.
[/list]

Anyway, yeah - sign up for my mailing list at [url=https://www.keithburgun.net/signup]https://www.keithburgun.net/signup[/url]. If you do, you'll get some free stuff from time to time!

Thanks for supporting Auro for all these years! I can't believe it's been like... 11 or 12 years since I started working on it. As to the future of Auro, it's uncertain. But I definitely hope that I can at least make sure it stays up, as it's a super cool game that I'm really proud of. Most updates though will probably come through the Keith Burgun Games funnel, so make sure to stay tuned on there.

<3

Keith

notes.title: Auro 3.2 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! If you missed our last post, it talked more about the details, but Auro 3.2 is LIVE! It's a big one! Please check it out. In addition to this list of patch notes, I've also added some more achievements. See if you can become a GRANDMASTER!

3.2 PATCH NOTES
- Added a basic custom match feature, that allows you to play an unranked game at any rank
- Added Grandmaster rank! New Quillsh dialogue lines and hud art that are much nicer for players rank 20 and up.
- Added Charles the Slime. Does 1 damage and follows you after bumping, 0CD. Doesn't flatten upon being bumped. Only in Platinum+
- Removed red text that would appear sometimes as a result of usually harmless bugs but made the game unplayable
- Changed Win Streak values from 0, 0, 6, 12, 18, 24, 30 to 0, 10, 30, 50, 75, 75, 75.
- Improved spell descriptions which were terrible before.
- Decreased score goals across the board - you'll have to reach rank 25 before the goal goes over 100 now.
- increased difficulty at Gold and Platinum (These two changes, let us know how they're going!)
- Curse Kids do 2 damage now.
- Snowball CD changed from 4 to 3. Also Snowball freezes all actors for just 1 turn now.

ENJOY!

Also, don't forget that we are doing Auro in the KBGames Game Design Book Club! There's a lot of discussion about Auro happening over at that Discord, so come and say hi!

https://discord.gg/g8zYQV8

notes.title: Version 3.1!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I'll keep it short and sweet. There are a bunch of small quality of life fixes for this version.
[list]
[*][b]ACHIEVEMENTS![/b] It finally happened. We now have our first 9 achievements in the game. They're nothing too crazy yet. For the next patch I'm gonna start adding some really fun ones, like "killed a squid with a frozen monster" (did you know you could do that?!) and stuff like that. But hey, we have achievements now! (Also, heads up, I'm not sure I have the notifications working yet, but the achievements WILL register in your Steam account when you get them... at least, I'm pretty sure they will (let me know!)
[*]Arguably more important than achievements are some fine tuning to power tile-economy in the game. The opening area was way too bereft of power tiles before, causing the early game of a lot of matches to be extremely cruel, randomly, sometimes. Now there should be a more regular ability for Auro to collect power tiles.
[*]A bunch more quality of life stuff regarding how animations look and camera movement stuff.
[/list]

Let us know what you think!

notes.title: Auro 3.0 - the beginning of a new era!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! So, you might remember that back when we first launched Auro on Steam back in 2016, the biggest complaint was "why can't we fullscreen". It's hard to believe, but since then over the years we've had about half a dozen different programmers come at that problem trying to solve it, and all of them weren't able to do it. It's a really weird, old mix of a bunch of outdated frameworks that Auro was originally built on (we started it in 2011, after all).

(I know there are some coders here thinking, pfft, how hard could it be? That's what every coder said until they got all set up with the repo and everything!)

Anyways. A few months ago Brett Lowey and I of BrainGoodGames (go check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/655480/Solar_Settlers/]SOLAR SETTLERS[/url]!) worked out a deal: he would code for us a UNITY PORT of Auro!

Cut to: now! We now have an all-new, fresh version of Auro! We're so pumped. Auro 3.0 (as we're calling it) is pretty darn similar to the Auro 2.0 you knew and loved. But there have been a bunch of bugfixes and actually some subtle rule improvements too! The big news is:

- You can now do [b]FULLSCREEN [/b]as well as different screen resolutions
- There is now a [b]RANK SELECTOR[/b] which lets you set your rank at 5, 10, or 15

Beyond that, the options going forward are limitless! We can port this easily to Android going forward, and possibly iOS even! There are some threads over on the Steam forums where you can submit your thoughts as to what you'd like to see in the game next.

Thanks for all your patience. Happy bumping!
